## Activity

During April 2024, Market Eye Clinic recorded 421 captures. This represents the site’s activity for the month and provides the basis for reviewing image quality and grading outcomes. The recorded volume should be considered alongside the number of images available for assessment and the number requiring further review. The activity record indicates that capture services were delivered throughout the reporting period, with all 421 captures included in the monthly return.

## Image quality

Of the 421 captures, 94 were ungradable. The ungradable rate was 22.3. These images could not be used for grading and therefore form a distinct part of the monthly quality results. The rate should be monitored with future returns to support assessment of image capture performance at Market Eye Clinic. The figures identify the scale of images requiring attention without changing the recorded activity total.

## Grading

A total of 110 results were recorded as referable during April 2024. The median lag for grading was 2. This provides the reported measure of the time between capture and grading for the month. Together, the referable results and median lag describe the grading outcome and timeliness recorded for the site.
